tei:div.tei:p: (649)ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.aḥ hūm̐/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ longs spyod mchog gi dam tshig rdzas/ phyi nang gsang mchod lha mo'i tshogs/ ye shes rol pa'i rdzas su gyur/ hūm̐/ o rgyan pad+ma yab yum dang*/ brgyud gsum rig 'jin bla mar bcas/ sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha/ zhi khro khrag 'thung ḍāk+ki'i tshogs/ chos skyong lha srin 'khor dang bcas/ (650)gzhi bdag dkar phyogs theg chen rigs/ thams cad yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs/ o rgyan yab yum chos kyi sku/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ brgyud gsum rig 'jin sprul skur bcas/ gnas yul ḍāk+ki chos srung la/ tshogs kyi mchod 'bul dngos grub zhu/ thugs dam gnyan skong nyams pa bshags/ gzung 'jin rū tra dbyings su sgrol/ dkyil (651)(652)'khor mtha' skyong lhag la ral/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ ma hā ga ṇa tsa kra la khā hi/
ces rdo rje'i mchod kyis bskul ngor sngags btsun las 'brel rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i snying thig gzhung nas btus pa'o/ 'di la byin rlabs shin tu che bar yid dam/// /
